phase1b2a_subcutaneous_obesity.note: Abstract: 'A large number of participants withdrew'; per-part placebo counts not in abstract (24 across five parts, about 5 per part on average, our arithmetic).

ann_intern_med_review_amycretin_placebo_.jabbit_note: Equals Part C (20 mg, -22.0% vs +1.9%) of the phase 1b/2a trial; the abstract does not say which arm was used.

novo_cmd_2026_09_21.slide_note: Data shown for weight loss is if all people adhered to treatment, estimated means

caveat: Cross-trial, not head-to-head; early zenagamtide trials are small, short and use on-treatment or adherence-based estimates.
